sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 14313 of 2021

Applicant :- Shravan Kumar
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And Ors.

Counsel for Applicant :- Braj Bhan Singh,Mahesh Kumar Kaushal Man
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Upendra Prakash Pathak
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.

Heard Sri Mahesh Kumar Kaushal Man, the learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Srinivas Bajpai,
learned A.G.A. for the State, Sri Upendra Kumar Pathak, the learned counsel for the informant and
perused the records.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
0277 of 2021, under Sections 376-D, 323, 504, 506, 315, 344 Ipc & 3/4 Pocso Act and 3(2)(v) of
Sc/St Act, Police Station Asandra, District Barabanki.

3.  The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 17.08.2021 against seven named accused persons, including the applicant, stating that six named accused persons had repetitively raped the informant's daughter aged about 13 years.
When she became pregnant, the accused persons beaten her with intent to cause her miscarriage.
4. In the statement of the informant recorded under Sections 161 Cr.P.C., she reiterated the FIR version.

5. The victim has fully supported the FIR allegations in her statements recorded under Sections 161 Shravan Kumar vs State Of U.P. And Ors. on 19 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/183238652/
1 and 164 Cr.P.C. and in both the statements, she has stated her age to be 15 years.

entities.text: Shravan Kumar vs State Of U.P. And Ors
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 6. In the radiological examination report, the victims age has been opined to be 14 years and she had delivered a male baby on 16.08.2021 in District Woman Hospital, Barabanki.

7. Learned counsel for the informant has submitted that the bail application of the co-accused Chandra Prakash Tiwari has been rejected by means of an order dated 13.10.2022 passed by this Court in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 763 of 2022.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 763 of 2022
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 8. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the FIR alleges impregnation of a minor girl by repetitive rape committed by six accused persons and the informant and the victim have categorically stated about the involvement of the applicant in the commission of crime, I am of the considered view that the aforesaid facts do not warrant exercise of discretion of this court in favour of the applicant by enlarging him on bail.
9. Accordingly, this bail application stands rejected.

Order Date :- 19.5.2023 Pradeep/-
